global.monetary_policy_notes: Fed held 3.50-3.75% at June meeting; ECB hiked +25bps in June; BoJ continued gradual normalization (hikes); BoE stayed cautious. Growing policy divergence across AEs.
global.market_notes: June 2026: S&P 500 closed ~7,499 (-1% MoM, best quarter since 2020); Nasdaq closed 26,214 after tech correction; Dow closed record >52,300 on rotation into industrials/healthcare/financials.
global.commodity_notes: Mid-June US-Iran ceasefire reopened Strait of Hormuz; Brent fell to ~US$73/bbl and WTI to ~US$71/bbl by month-end; gold mixed but elevated on central-bank buying.
global.source: IMF/World Bank/market commentary (narrative, no single indexed figure in text)
